back.es: divertirse: to have fun, to enjoy oneself (reflexive of divertir, to amuse)
back.example: Have a lot of fun at the party!

note: The list word is divertir, and the card teaches the reflexive divertirse, which is the form beginners actually use; pasarla bien (to have a good time) is close but is a phrase, so it does not compete as the answer.
